summary: The Inspect dialog gains a Raw checkbox that toggles between raw mm/s commands and values converted to the Job Machine's output units and precision, changes its note text and window title, becomes non-modal, adds a tooltip with raw G-code or operation data, and replaces the scripting entry point Path.Main.Gui.Inspect.show(obj) with GCodeEditorDialog(obj).exec().

pages.reason: Path/Main/Gui/Inspect.py: new 'Raw' checkbox in bottomFrame; updateText() converts F/S to per-minute and XYZIJK to inches, rounding to the Machine asset's axis/feed precision; the Note label text is rewritten; window title now includes the op label; dialog created with parent=None so it no longer darkens the main window; highlightpath() sets an editor tooltip with raw G-code of selected lines or op/tool summary; show(obj) is removed and CommandPathInspect calls GCodeEditorDialog(obj).exec()

meta.title: CAM: Inspect - Change units and round values
